subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server reply-session-init conflict leaves the session with no transcript mirror → tool-results silently return empty with no self-heal

question: Which open self-heal PR should be treated as the canonical fix path for this issue?
rationale: Two open PRs now overlap on the same reply-session-init recovery boundary, and cleanup automation should not close this issue or queue another fix while maintainers still need to choose and review the landing path.

options.title: Use Direct Linked PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the canonical fix because it directly closes this issue and includes the most issue-specific after-fix proof.

options.title: Switch To Broader PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102052 instead if maintainers prefer to solve the broader cross-channel conflict cluster through that branch after proof review.

options.title: Ask For Replacement
options.body: Close or supersede both PRs only if maintainers want a different owner-approved recovery design for the same session lifecycle boundary.

recommendation.title: Use Direct Linked PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 as the canonical fix because it directly closes this issue and includes the most issue-specific after-fix proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main blame and recent merged PR metadata identify this handle as the latest contributor to the central session initialization files available in this checkout.
